title: Seppic unveils Sepilife NEOS, a squalane-based hybrid polymer
summary: Seppic is expanding its Clean Beauty-focused Sepilife range with Sepilife NEOS, a patented hybrid polymer that combines a fresh sensory feel with thickening and stabilizing performance. It also enables cold-process formulation. Seppic is expanding its Sepilife range with Sepilife NEOS, a patented liquid polymer incorporating naturally derived squalane.
